28# GCU400 has 48 SPC per wave; a larger grid serializes in waves (see 

29# gcu400/ops/sum.py for the same fixed-grid + in-kernel stride precedent). 

30MAX_GRID = 48 

31# Per-program on-chip budget: x tile (fp32 after cast) + two fp32 accumulators. 

32DSM_BYTES = 448 * 1024

35@libentry() 

36@triton.jit 

37def batch_norm_stats_kernel_flat( 

38 input_pointer, 

39 mean_pointer, 

40 invstd_pointer, 

41 batch_dim, 

42 channel_dim, 

43 spatial_dim: tl.constexpr, 

44 flat_dim, 

45 eps, 

46 count, 

47 input_batch_stride, 

48 BLOCK_B: tl.constexpr, 

49 BLOCK_F: tl.constexpr, 

50 CHANNELS_PER_TASK: tl.constexpr, 

51 NUM_STAGES: tl.constexpr, 

52 DEFERRED_TREES: tl.constexpr, 

53): 

54 """Column-block kernel over the contiguous (channel, spatial) flat dim. 

55 

56 Each task reduces a BLOCK_F-wide contiguous column block of the 

57 row-major (batch, channel * spatial) view, i.e. memory-coalesced loads 

58 of BLOCK_F consecutive elements per batch row. Tasks are strided over 

59 the fixed 48-program grid, keeping the device in a single wave even 

60 for very large channel counts (the generic one-channel-per-program 

61 grid serializes in C / 48 waves). 

62 

63 DEFERRED_TREES=1 keeps two [BLOCK_B, BLOCK_F] fp32 accumulators and 

64 reduces once in the epilogue (fewest per-element ops); 0 reduces each 

65 tile immediately (smaller accumulator footprint for fp32 tiles). 

66 """ 

67 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

68 num_tasks = tl.cdiv(flat_dim, BLOCK_F) 

69 flat_offsets = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_F) 

70 for task in tl.range(pid, num_tasks, tl.num_programs(0)): 

71 flat_base = task * BLOCK_F 

72 flat_mask = flat_base + flat_offsets < flat_dim 

73 if DEFERRED_TREES == 1: 

74 sum_2d = tl.zeros([BLOCK_B, BLOCK_F], dtype=tl.float32) 

75 sumsq_2d = tl.zeros([BLOCK_B, BLOCK_F], dtype=tl.float32) 

76 else: 

77 sum_1d = tl.zeros([BLOCK_F], dtype=tl.float32) 

78 sumsq_1d = tl.zeros([BLOCK_F], dtype=tl.float32) 

79 for batch_start in tl.range(0, batch_dim, BLOCK_B, num_stages=NUM_STAGES): 

80 batch_offsets = batch_start + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_B) 

81 pointers = ( 

82 input_pointer 

83 + batch_offsets[:, None] * input_batch_stride 

84 + (flat_base + flat_offsets)[None, :] 

85 ) 

86 mask = (batch_offsets[:, None] < batch_dim) & flat_mask[None, :] 

87 x = tl.load(pointers, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32) 

88 if DEFERRED_TREES == 1: 

89 sum_2d += x 

90 sumsq_2d += x * x 

91 else: 

92 sum_1d += tl.sum(x, axis=0) 

93 sumsq_1d += tl.sum(x * x, axis=0) 

94 if DEFERRED_TREES == 1: 

95 sum_1d = tl.sum(sum_2d, axis=0) 

96 sumsq_1d = tl.sum(sumsq_2d, axis=0) 

97 channel_sum = tl.sum(sum_1d.reshape(CHANNELS_PER_TASK, spatial_dim), axis=1) 

98 channel_sumsq = tl.sum(sumsq_1d.reshape(CHANNELS_PER_TASK, spatial_dim), axis=1) 

99 mean = channel_sum / count 

100 var = channel_sumsq / count - mean * mean 

101 invstd = 1.0 / tl.sqrt(var + eps) 

102 channel_base = flat_base // spatial_dim 

103 channel_offsets = channel_base + tl.arange(0, CHANNELS_PER_TASK) 

104 channel_mask = channel_offsets < channel_dim 

105 tl.store(mean_pointer + channel_offsets, mean, mask=channel_mask) 

106 tl.store(invstd_pointer + channel_offsets, invstd, mask=channel_mask)

111def batch_norm_stats_kernel_per_channel( 

112 input_pointer, 

113 mean_pointer, 

114 invstd_pointer, 

115 batch_dim, 

116 channel_dim, 

117 spatial_dim, 

118 eps, 

119 count, 

120 input_batch_stride, 

121 input_channel_stride, 

122 BLOCK_B: tl.constexpr, 

123 BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr, 

124 BATCH_STAGES: tl.constexpr, 

125 SPATIAL_STAGES: tl.constexpr, 

126 DEFERRED_TREES: tl.constexpr, 

127): 

128 """One channel per task, strided over the 48 SPCs of the grid. 

129 

130 Every task walks the batch/spatial plane of a single channel with 

131 [BLOCK_B, BLOCK_N] tiles. Two accumulator shapes are kept because the 

132 winner depends on the tile size (probe: GCU400/L600, kernel-mode 

133 do_bench): 

134 

135 - DEFERRED_TREES=1 keeps a [BLOCK_B, BLOCK_N] fp32 accumulator pair and 

136 folds it only once at the end. This is the fastest form for the wide 

137 16K-element tiles of the large shapes, but the accumulator dominates the 

138 on-chip budget. 

139 - DEFERRED_TREES=0 folds every tile into a [BLOCK_N] accumulator pair, so 

140 a narrow tile pays one cross-lane reduction per load instead. Cheaper 

141 for micro tiles, where the wide accumulator pair would cost more DSM 

142 than the data it saves. 

143 """ 

144 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

145 spatial_offsets = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N) 

146 for channel in tl.range(pid, channel_dim, tl.num_programs(0)): 

147 channel_base = input_pointer + channel * input_channel_stride 

148 if DEFERRED_TREES == 1: 

149 sum_2d = tl.zeros([BLOCK_B, BLOCK_N], dtype=tl.float32) 

150 sumsq_2d = tl.zeros([BLOCK_B, BLOCK_N], dtype=tl.float32) 

151 else: 

152 sum_1d = tl.zeros([BLOCK_N], dtype=tl.float32) 

153 sumsq_1d = tl.zeros([BLOCK_N], dtype=tl.float32) 

154 for batch_start in tl.range(0, batch_dim, BLOCK_B, num_stages=BATCH_STAGES): 

155 batch_offsets = batch_start + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_B) 

156 batch_mask = batch_offsets < batch_dim 

157 for spatial_start in tl.range( 

158 0, spatial_dim, BLOCK_N, num_stages=SPATIAL_STAGES 

159 ): 

160 spatial_vec = spatial_start + spatial_offsets 

161 pointers = ( 

162 channel_base 

163 + batch_offsets[:, None] * input_batch_stride 

164 + spatial_vec[None, :] 

165 ) 

166 mask = batch_mask[:, None] & (spatial_vec < spatial_dim)[None, :] 

167 x = tl.load(pointers, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32) 

168 if DEFERRED_TREES == 1: 

169 sum_2d += x 

170 sumsq_2d += x * x 

171 else: 

172 sum_1d += tl.sum(x, axis=0) 

173 sumsq_1d += tl.sum(x * x, axis=0) 

174 if DEFERRED_TREES == 1: 

175 sum_1d = tl.sum(sum_2d, axis=0) 

176 sumsq_1d = tl.sum(sumsq_2d, axis=0) 

177 total_sum = tl.sum(sum_1d) 

178 total_sumsq = tl.sum(sumsq_1d) 

179 mean = total_sum / count 

180 var = total_sumsq / count - mean * mean 

181 tl.store(mean_pointer + channel, mean) 

182 tl.store(invstd_pointer + channel, 1.0 / tl.sqrt(var + eps))

185def _flat_launch_config(batch_dim, channel_dim, spatial_dim, flat_dim): 

186 """Probe-tuned (GCU400/L600, kernel-mode do_bench) launch geometry. 

187 

188 - spatial == 1: target ~32 column tasks; deferred trees, num_warps 2. 

189 - Column blocks (spatial > 1): one 4096-wide block per task (wider blocks 

190 lose: 8192-wide is 1.46x slower on 64x512x512), a 32K-element tile 

191 budget, immediate per-tile trees and num_warps 4. Probes: 2048-wide 

192 blocks are 4.4x slower than 4096-wide on 64x512x512 (424us vs 97us), and 

193 the previous 16K budget cost 1.26x on 1024x1024x512 (2429us vs 1925us). 

194 """ 

195 if spatial_dim == 1: 

196 block_f = max(32, triton.next_power_of_2(max(1, flat_dim // 32))) 

197 block_b = min(16384 // block_f, triton.next_power_of_2(batch_dim)) 

198 return block_b, block_f, 2, 2, 1 

199 max_block_f = 4096 

200 block_f = max( 

201 spatial_dim, 

202 min(triton.next_power_of_2(max(1, flat_dim // MAX_GRID)), max_block_f), 

203 ) 

204 if block_f >= 16384: 

205 # A single 16K-element block row per task: one [1, BLOCK_F] tile per 

206 # step needs the widest warp allocation (probe: nw4 -8.8%/-2.2%). 

207 return 1, block_f, 4, 1, 1 

208 budget = 32768 

209 block_b = min(max(1, budget // block_f), triton.next_power_of_2(batch_dim)) 

210 return block_b, block_f, 4, 1, 0

213def _per_channel_launch_config(batch_dim, channel_dim, spatial_dim): 

214 """Probe-tuned geometry for the one-channel-per-task kernel. 

215 

216 Probes (GCU400/L600, kernel-mode do_bench) on 16x16x64, 16x16x1024, 

217 16x16x4098, 16x8x128x128 and 8x32x224x224: 

218 

219 - 1024-wide tiles below a 8192-element spatial dim, 4096-wide above; the 

220 wider tile loses on the short-spatial shapes (28.5us vs 15.1us on 

221 16x16x4098). 

222 - A 32K-element tile budget keeps a single [BLOCK_B, BLOCK_N] tile close to 

223 the 448KB DSM budget (-28% on 8x32x224x224 vs the previous 16K budget). 

224 - num_warps 4 pays for itself as soon as the tile is wider than a micro 

225 tile, and SPATIAL_STAGES=2 hides the latency of the strided batch rows. 

226 - Micro tiles (<= 1024 elements) are launch-bound: narrow warps, no 

227 pipelining and immediate per-tile trees beat every deferred variant 

228 (-37% on 16x16x64). Below 64 elements the accumulator pair is free, so 

229 deferred trees win again (16x16x4098-style 16-element tiles). 

230 - Large tiles: deferred trees hold a third DSM buffer, so they only pay off 

231 while the grid is short of a full wave (channel_dim < MAX_GRID/2) and the 

232 spatial loop actually iterates. Probe table, deferred vs immediate: 

233 C=8 , 4 iters : 22.4us vs 25.8us (16x8x128x128, fp16) 

234 C=16, 5 iters : 13.3us vs 14.2us (16x16x4098, fp16) 

235 C=16, 49 iters: 71.8us vs 87.4us (4x16x448x448, fp16) 

236 C=32, 13 iters: 58.4us vs 43.0us (8x32x224x224, fp16) <- immediate 

237 C=32, 16 iters: 125.7us vs 93.2us (16x32x256x256, fp16) <- immediate 

238 C=48, 4 iters : 224.6us vs 188.0us (64x64x128x128, fp16)<- immediate 

239 C=16, 1 iter : 8.1us vs 7.0us (16x16x1024, fp16) <- launch bound 

240 """ 

241 block_n = min( 

242 triton.next_power_of_2(spatial_dim), 4096 if spatial_dim >= 8192 else 1024 

243 ) 

244 tile_budget = 32768 

245 block_b = min(max(tile_budget // block_n, 1), triton.next_power_of_2(batch_dim)) 

246 tile = block_b * block_n 

247 if tile < 64: 

248 return block_b, block_n, 1, 1, 1, 1 

249 if tile <= 1024: 

250 return block_b, block_n, 1, 1, 1, 0 

251 # Large tiles: keep the deferred accumulator pair only for grids that leave 

252 # at least half of the SPCs idle and whose spatial loop runs more than once. 

253 spatial_iters = triton.cdiv(spatial_dim, block_n) 

254 busy_tasks = min(MAX_GRID, channel_dim) 

255 deferred = 1 if spatial_iters > 1 and busy_tasks < MAX_GRID // 2 else 0 

256 return block_b, block_n, 4, 1, 2, deferred

259def batch_norm_stats(input, eps): 

260 """Compute batch normalization statistics (mean and invstd) per channel. 

261 

262 Args: 

263 input: Tensor of shape (N, C, *spatial_dims) 

264 eps: Small constant for numerical stability 

265 

266 Returns: 

267 Tuple of (mean, invstd), each of shape (C,) 

268 """ 

269 logger.debug("GEMS_ENFLAME BATCH_NORM_STATS") 

270 

271 assert input.ndim >= 2, "Input must have at least 2 dimensions (N, C, ...)" 

272 

273 # Reshape to 3D: (N, C, spatial) 

274 N = input.shape[0] 

275 C = input.shape[1] 

276 

277 if input.ndim == 2: 

278 input_3d = input.unsqueeze(-1).contiguous() 

279 elif input.ndim >= 4: 

280 input_3d = input.flatten(2, -1).contiguous() 

281 else: 

282 input_3d = input.contiguous() 

283 

284 spatial = input_3d.shape[2] 

285 flat_dim = C * spatial 

286 

287 # Output tensors 

288 mean = torch.empty(C, dtype=torch.float32, device=input.device) 

289 invstd = torch.empty(C, dtype=torch.float32, device=input.device) 

290 # Element count per channel, precomputed on the host: a kernel-side 

291 # (batch_dim * spatial_dim).to(tl.float32) breaks when triton 

292 # specializes batch_dim == 1 into a python int. 

293 count = float(N * spatial) 

294 

295 with torch_device_fn.device(input.device): 

296 # Two decompositions, picked by how many channel-aligned tasks the 

297 # shape can produce: 

298 # 

299 # - Column-block (flat) kernel: task boundaries land on channel 

300 # boundaries, which needs a power-of-two spatial dim within the block 

301 # cap and a batch dim > 1. It is the best form when it can keep the 

302 # whole 48-SPC wave busy; below one full wave the per-channel arm 

303 # (whose tasks stride over all channels) wastes less of the machine 

304 # and wins (-37% on 16x16x64, -21% on 16x8x128x128). 

305 # spatial == 1 keeps its dedicated column arm. 

306 # - Per-channel kernel: one channel per task, any spatial size. 

307 spatial_is_blockable = ( 

308 (spatial & (spatial - 1)) == 0 and spatial <= 16384 and N > 1 

309 ) 

310 flat_geometry = None 

311 flat_tasks = 0 

312 if spatial_is_blockable: 

313 flat_geometry = _flat_launch_config(N, C, spatial, flat_dim) 

314 flat_tasks = triton.cdiv(flat_dim, flat_geometry[1]) 

315 use_flat_arm = spatial_is_blockable and (spatial == 1 or flat_tasks >= MAX_GRID) 

316 if use_flat_arm: 

317 block_b, block_f, num_warps, num_stages, deferred = flat_geometry 

318 channels_per_task = block_f // spatial 

319 # On-chip budget: fp32 x tile plus (deferred) fp32 accumulators. 

320 assert ( 

321 block_b * block_f * 4 * (3 if deferred else 1) <= DSM_BYTES 

322 ), "flat kernel tile exceeds the DSM budget" 

323 grid = (min(MAX_GRID, flat_tasks),) 

324 batch_norm_stats_kernel_flat[grid]( 

325 input_3d, 

326 mean, 

327 invstd, 

328 N, 

329 C, 

330 spatial, 

331 flat_dim, 

332 eps, 

333 count, 

334 input_3d.stride(0), 

335 BLOCK_B=block_b, 

336 BLOCK_F=block_f, 

337 CHANNELS_PER_TASK=channels_per_task, 

338 NUM_STAGES=num_stages, 

339 DEFERRED_TREES=deferred, 

340 num_warps=num_warps, 

341 ) 

342 else: 

343 ( 

344 block_b, 

345 block_n, 

346 num_warps, 

347 batch_stages, 

348 spatial_stages, 

349 deferred, 

350 ) = _per_channel_launch_config(N, C, spatial) 

351 assert ( 

352 block_b * block_n * 4 * (3 if deferred else 1) <= DSM_BYTES 

353 ), "per-channel kernel tile exceeds the DSM budget" 

354 grid = (min(MAX_GRID, C),) 

355 batch_norm_stats_kernel_per_channel[grid]( 

356 input_3d, 

357 mean, 

358 invstd, 

359 N, 

360 C, 

361 spatial, 

362 eps, 

363 count, 

364 input_3d.stride(0), 

365 input_3d.stride(1), 

366 BLOCK_B=block_b, 

367 BLOCK_N=block_n, 

368 BATCH_STAGES=batch_stages, 

369 SPATIAL_STAGES=spatial_stages, 

370 DEFERRED_TREES=deferred, 

371 num_warps=num_warps, 

372 ) 

373 

374 return mean, invstd
